#Landlord.Misc.money
He quickly flipped through the money, presumably to count it, but the speed at which he flipped it was way, way too fast for that. 
How can someone count money that fast? I doubt even money counting machines can do it. He really is something else when it comes to money.
Landlord: Looks good. As always, it was a pleasure doing business with you.
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5)
He left without saying goodbye…
